rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a friend you exchange letters or messages with but rarely meet.

example.english: My penfriend lives in Australia; we keep in touch by email, but we have never met.
example.traditional: 我個筆友住喺澳洲，我哋成日用電郵聯絡，但一直未見過面。
